issues.description: The UML in the problem statement defines Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean, but the provided solution implements addAnimal(Animal) with a void return type and the template does not include the method. This inconsistency can confuse students about the expected return type and whether they should implement a boolean-returning addAnimal or a void one.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the UML and problem text to show addAnimal(Animal): void (and ensure template and solution use void), or (B) change the template and solution to implement addAnimal(Animal): boolean (e.g., return true when the animal is successfully added) and update any references accordingly. Ensure the template includes the method signature matching the chosen return type so students have a clear target.
